mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% signals sustained monetary accommodation that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate financing costs decline.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly federal funds rate increase above 0.5% signals monetary tightening that raises equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as valuation pressures intensify.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate collapsing consumer demand, triggering equity sell-offs as corporate revenue expectations deteriorate and S&P 500 returns turn negative over 20 days.
failure_condition: Joint decline of HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative SPX returns (p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.04 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 9.0%), rising payroll employment (PAYEMS growth > 0.1%) signals labor market recovery that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of periods with UNRATE > 9.0% and PAYEMS growth > 0.1%, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) indicates manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output and profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as near-term earnings expectations fall.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >55% of INDPRO decline periods, or Rank IC < 0.04 over 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly retail sales decline exceeding 0.5% (RSAFS growth < -0.5%) signals weakening consumer spending that reduces corporate revenue visibility, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >45% of RSAFS growth < -0.5% periods, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate revenue expectations decline.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of UNRATE rise periods, or Rank IC < 0.05 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 90.0 signals severe manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output and profit visibility, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as near-term earnings face pressure.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >45% of INDPRO < 90.0 periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year window.
